@deskScanStarting.description: Scan dialog: shown in the camera area until the camera's picture appears.

deskScanAim: Hold the code in front of the camera.

@deskScanAim.description: Scan dialog: the line under the camera picture while scanning.

@deskScanTryAgain.description: Scan dialog: button that starts the camera again after it stopped. Never pressed by the app itself.

deskScanDeniedWindows: Camera access is off in Windows Settings › Privacy & security › Camera.

@deskScanDeniedWindows.description: Scan dialog, Windows: the system does not let the app open the camera. Use the Windows settings page names of the language.

deskScanDeniedMac: Camera access is off in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Camera.

@deskScanDeniedMac.description: Scan dialog, macOS: the system does not let the app open the camera. Use the macOS settings names of the language.

deskScanDeniedLinux: This app is not allowed to open the camera.

@deskScanDeniedLinux.description: Scan dialog, Linux: the system refused to open the camera (permissions, a sandbox portal).

deskScanUnsupportedLinux: Camera support (GStreamer) is missing on this system.

@deskScanUnsupportedLinux.description: Scan dialog and the line beside paste, Linux: the GStreamer libraries the camera needs are not installed. Keep 'GStreamer' as is.

deskScanUnsupportedWindows: The Windows media features are missing.

@deskScanUnsupportedWindows.description: Scan dialog and the line beside paste, Windows: Windows N editions without the Media Feature Pack.

deskScanUnsupportedOther: Camera support is missing on this system.

@deskScanUnsupportedOther.description: Scan dialog and the line beside paste, other systems: what the camera needs is not there.

deskScanBusy: Another app is using the camera.

@deskScanBusy.description: Scan dialog: the camera is held by another app.

@deskScanFailed.description: Scan dialog: the camera failed to start for another reason (a driver error).

@deskScanNoPicture.description: Scan dialog: the camera opened but sends no picture, or a frozen one.

deskScanDark: The camera picture is black. Its cover may be closed.

@deskScanDark.description: Scan dialog: shown over a black picture (a closed lens cover or shutter); it goes away when the picture comes back.

@deskScanUnplugged.description: Scan dialog: the camera went away during the scan (unplugged).

deskScanReaderFailed: The QR reader did not start.

@deskScanReaderFailed.description: Scan dialog: the part that reads QR codes from the picture failed to load.

deskScanNoCamera: No camera found. Paste the code instead.

@deskScanNoCamera.description: The quiet line under a paste field when this computer has no camera; Scan is greyed out.
